scope.priority: OLE2 and OOXML remain the active priority; ODF deferred until that goal completes; iWork excluded.

hypothesis.statement: SharedOleFile::read_stream_range and SharedOleStreamCursor::read_exact each observe ReadAt::version() twice per call - once before the payload read and once after. The pre-read observation is redundant because expected_version is captured and fenced at open and every checked operation ends with a post-read fence, so each read is already bracketed by the previous operation's successful fence and its own post-read fence. On a FileSource each observation is one statx syscall.
hypothesis.mechanism: Deleting the two pre-read fences halves the number of ReadAt::version() calls issued by the shared CFB reader per physical read.
hypothesis.predicted_primary_effect: version_calls per measured XLS operation falls by approximately one half; whole-child statx syscall count falls by approximately one half; file-source elapsed p50 falls because version probes were measured at roughly half of file-source elapsed time in the frozen baseline.
hypothesis.predicted_null_effect: owned-readat mode elapsed changes little because its version() observation performs no syscall.

groups.name: latency-abba
groups.child_scope: one child per (repeat, leg, mode, operation); samples share that child's process

groups.name: syscall-counts
groups.metric: whole-child statx and pread64 call counts; deterministic, not a timing measurement

acceptance.primary_gate: deterministic: candidate version_calls must be strictly lower than baseline for every measured cell, and whole-child statx counts must fall, with read_calls and read_bytes unchanged and every semantic oracle projection identical.
acceptance.secondary_gate: paired file-source elapsed p50 must improve in BOTH ABBA directions for the accepted cells; any cell that does not improve in both directions is reported and not accepted.
acceptance.regression_trigger: any cell with more than 5% adverse p50/mean movement is reported explicitly and not hidden in an aggregate.
acceptance.stability_precondition: same-binary drift between R1 and R2 on the A legs is reported; cells whose same-binary drift exceeds 5% are reported as unstable and excluded from acceptance.
